name: Obturator Internus / Deep Hip Rotator Strain
tags: obturator internus / deep hip rotator strain
definition: Strain of deep hip rotator musculature such as obturator internus, causing deep buttock or posterior hip pain after twisting or sport.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI is used for high-grade injury or persistent unclear symptoms.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent neuropathic symptoms require reassessment for nerve entrapment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Strain of deep hip rotator musculature such as obturator internus, causing deep buttock or posterior hip pain after twisting or sport.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
